features.name: oc_comment_count
features.definition: How many counter-argument comments by other users are in the discussion's comment list?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads; return len(list). Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed JSON gives null. Counts comments, not distinct commenters.

h0: oc_comment_count has no association with the likelihood that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher oc_comment_count is associated with a higher likelihood of the OP changing their view (fewer comments, lower likelihood).
note: "Fewer counter-argument responses" is operationalized as a lower count of comments in OC_comments (available comments by other users), tested linearly with OLS (linear probability). The list may be a sampled or truncated subset of all responses, and it may include comments made after or because of a view change; its timing is unknown. This is an association, not a causal effect.
